newsitem.title: USA: Proteon sees Q4 loss, including charge.
newsitem.headline: Proteon sees Q4 loss, including charge.

text.p: Proteon Inc said Thursday it expects to report a loss ranging from $0.45 to $0.55 per share for the fourth quarter, including a restructuring charge for staff cuts and other items.

Proteon said the restructuring charge, to range from $0.29 to $0.37 per share, reflects its move to create OpenROUTE Networks Inc, a subsidiary that will focus on the Remote Access Internet/Intranet connectivity market.
The company said it will report final results for the quarter on February 11.
